entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio Zapata y Cisneros, also listed as Zapata y Mendoza, was a Spanish bishop. He served as bishop of Cádiz and Pamplona, archbishop of Burgos, cardinal, councillor of state for Philip III, Viceroy of Naples, and Inquisitor General of the realm.
